Vue's reactivity for the page: ref(), reactive(), computed(), watch()

Source: R/vue_state.R
vue_reactivity.Rd

State the page's components share, in the browser, made with Vue's own functions – the shapes Shiny's server has, on the other side:

Usage

vue_ref(id, value = NULL, input = FALSE)

vue_reactive(id, value = list(), input = FALSE)

vue_computed(id, expr, ns = NULL, input = FALSE)

vue_watch(
  source,
  handler,
  immediate = FALSE,
  deep = FALSE,
  ns = NULL,
  use = NULL
)

Arguments

id

The state's name: $vueRef.<id>, and input$<id>.

value

The initial value: for vue_reactive(), a named list.

input

Whether to report it as input$<id>.

expr, source

A JavaScript expression over the page's state, a string: "$vueRef.count * 2".

ns

In a module, its namespace: the function shiny::NS() gives, session$ns, or the module's id.

handler

What vue_watch() runs: Vue's inline statement, a string, or a JS() function function(value, oldValue).

immediate, deep

As Vue's watch(): run once at the start; follow changes inside objects.

use

For vue_watch(), the Vue plugins its statement uses, as vue_app()'s: a component library's message service, for one.

Value

A tag to put on the page; it draws nothing.

Details

Shiny (server)VueHere (browser)Read as
reactiveVal()ref()vue_ref(id, value)$vueRef.<id>
reactiveValues()reactive()vue_reactive(id, list())$vueReactive.<id>.<field>
reactive()computed()vue_computed(id, expr)$vueComputed.<id>
observe()watch()vue_watch(source, handler)–

Each component is a Vue app of its own, and a template compiled in the browser cannot import: what upstream shares through a module of refs, these share through the names every app sees – in templates, in v_bind() and v_model() expressions, in on statements, and in a component's setup() as shinyVue.useRef(id), useReactive(id), useComputed(id). A vue_store() is the same with Pinia's getters and actions, for a whole piece of logic.

Each is a component of the page with no markup, so the server reaches it as any: input = TRUE reports it as input$<id> (a ref's and a computed's value, a reactive's object), and update_vue(session, id, value = ) sets a ref, update_vue(session, id, <field> = ) a reactive's field.

vue_watch() runs handler whenever source changes: Vue's inline statement, with $value and $oldValue, or a JS() function of the two. It acts in the browser – a store set, a message from a component library it is given with use – and stops when it leaves the page.

In a module, give the id as ns("count") and ns to the expressions that read it, as for v_bind().

See also

vue_store(); v_bind(), v_model() to bind arguments to them.

Examples

htmltools::tagList(
  vue_ref("count", 0),
  vue_computed("twice", "$vueRef.count * 2"),
  vue_watch(
    "$vueRef.count",
    "console.log('count is', $value)"
  ),
  vue_app(
    "counter",
    htmltools::tags$button(
      v_on(click = "$vueRef.count++"),
      "{{ $vueRef.count }} -> {{ $vueComputed.twice }}"
    )
  )
)
#> <div id="count" data-shiny-vue style="display: contents">
#>   <script type="text/x-template" data-shiny-vue-template><span hidden></span></script>
#>   <script type="application/json" data-shiny-vue-options>{"options":{"data":{"value":0}},"state":{"kind":"ref"},"evals":[]}</script>
#> </div>
#> <div id="twice" data-shiny-vue style="display: contents">
#>   <script type="text/x-template" data-shiny-vue-template><span hidden></span></script>
#>   <script type="application/json" data-shiny-vue-options>{"options":{"data":[]},"state":{"kind":"computed","expr":{"expr":"$vueRef.count * 2"}},"evals":[]}</script>
#> </div>
#> <div id="vue_watch_9ca8955a-782e-4974-a50e-5ced4c423a09" data-shiny-vue style="display: contents">
#>   <script type="text/x-template" data-shiny-vue-template><span hidden></span></script>
#>   <script type="application/json" data-shiny-vue-options>{"options":{"data":[]},"state":{"kind":"watch","source":{"expr":"$vueRef.count"},"handler":"console.log('count is', $value)","statement":true,"immediate":false,"deep":false},"evals":[]}</script>
#> </div>
#> <div id="counter" data-shiny-vue style="display: contents">
#>   <script type="text/x-template" data-shiny-vue-template><button @click="$vueRef.count++">{{ $vueRef.count }} -&gt; {{ $vueComputed.twice }}</button></script>
#>   <script type="application/json" data-shiny-vue-options>{"options":{"data":[]},"evals":[]}</script>
#> </div>
